error-body: The action catalog did not load, so screened actions cannot be named. This is usually temporary.
intro: Every candidate action is checked against the laws that apply to your municipality. The check does not remove actions: it lowers the score of those your city cannot implement on its own authority, and shows here where each ranked action stands.
precondition-title: Legal screening runs when your ranking is generated
precondition-body: Finish the remaining wizard steps and generate your ranking — each candidate action will then be checked against local laws, and its legal standing will appear here. You can continue to the next step now.
precondition-continue: No action needed here — continue to the next step.
summary-body: Whether your municipality can implement each of the {{count}} ranked actions on its own authority, as assessed by the legal review.
section-blocked-description: The municipality cannot implement these actions on its own authority. They stay in the ranking with the lowest legal score, so they rank below comparable actions; delivering them needs another level of government or a legal change.
section-conditional-description: The municipality can implement these actions only under conditions — an agreement, a permit or a shared competence. The legal score reflects that.
section-enabled-description: The municipality has direct authority to implement these actions.
section-not-assessed-description: No legal assessment was available for these actions. They are ranked with a neutral legal score.
all-enabled-title: Every ranked action is within municipal authority
all-enabled-body: No ranked action is blocked or conditional on authority the municipality does not have.
excluded-section-description: These actions were removed before scoring and do not appear in the ranking.
reason-legal-verdict-blocked: The legal review found no municipal authority for this action, so it was removed before scoring.
reason-user-excluded: Removed by the city's own exclusion criteria.
reason-score-missing: A score the ranking needs was missing for this action.
reason-assessment-missing: No assessment was available for this action.
